summary: Pin sits in dense bush with no track or vehicle access.
reasons: Thick bush, no track or tyre marks
Steep slope down to Cubberla Creek

drivers.seclusion: Bush reserve, but ringed by homes: nearest dwellings 42 to 45 m away and many more within 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: No formed track, gravel or tyre tracks reach the pin; only a small grassy patch by the road bend, with no sign vehicles use it.
drivers.traffic: Collector road bends past the reserve edge; a van there would stand on the verge of a through road.
drivers.convention: No vehicles or camping seen in the reserve.

flags: Steep: about 8% mean, 23% max at the pin
Mapped gate 60 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the pin; open to the sun only at the road-edge patch.
cannot_judge: Whether the road-edge patch is firm enough to stop on
Foot tracks hidden under the canopy
